notes.title: All the changes from v1.0.0 to v1.0.3
notes.content:
This is a recap of all the changes that have been done since the v1.0.0 release version of the game.

Did I miss something? Let me know in our social media!
Twitter: https://twitter.com/GutsAndGoals
Discord: https://discord.gg/wyRRCn9Zxd

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a button to skip the rest of unlockables notifications.
[*] 'How to play' and 'Grand Prix intermissions' can now be skipped with 'Esc' or 'Start button'.
[*] Game is now actually paused in offline modes.
[*] Added mouse lock to screen on windowed mode.
[*] Added option to enable/disable Auto-Aim.
[*] Added a new Grand Prix difficulty, unlocked for each character after completing Champion difficulty.
[*] Grand Prix's bonus levels now have 8 variations.
[*] Grand Prix's stage 3 now has a rare variation.
[*] Grand Prix's stage 5 & 7 now have 3 variations. 
[*] Added new bot AIs: Tom, Kurai, Bo and Hairry.
[*] Added one new unlockable.
[*] Screenshots can now be taken and shared on Steam by using the F12 key.
[/list]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI will now be a bit more unpredictable.
[*] You will go back to the Challenges screen after playing a challenge.
[*] 'Play again' button added to Challenges.
[*] Balanced some cards on MVP Hunter mode.
[*] Grand Prix's Stage 7 is now a bit easier on 'Beginner' and 'Amateur' difficulties.
[*] Skill icons are now shown on the skill tab in the character selection menu.
[*] Exiting from the pause menu now has an additional confirmation message.
[*] Gamepad deadzones adjusted.
[*] You can now exit the collection menu with ESC button.
[*] You can now start a game from the character selection menu with ENTER button.
[*] You can now exit the character selection menu with ESC button.
[*] The game can only be paused when no animations are hapenning.
[*] The ball and players will paint the stadium continuously in paintball minigame.
[*] Mouse and gamepad control should feel smoother now on menus.
[*] Bounding Box of player selection discs in character selection increased so they are easier to grab.
[*] You can now grab your player selection disc in the character selection menu from any point allowing quick character selection.
[*] Misc sound effects changes.
[*] Skill tab is now the default tab on character selection.
[/list]

[h2]ACCESIBILITY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gamepad vibration intensity can now be modified.
[*] GUI scale can now be modified.
[*] Bot names can now be disabled.
[*] HP bars should be now more visible.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ellie's skill on MVP Hunter mode won't be able to be used when KO anymore.
[*] Kurai's skill on MVP Hunter mode won't target the goal on some minigames anymore.
[*] Grand Prix fanfare doesn't get skipped after skipping the animation once.
[*] Auto-Aim is now enabled by default.
[*] Ray'O'Tron skill card on MVP Hunter will no longer cause problems.
[*] Skelly's boomerang will no longer be invisible in online mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that made all local players in the character selection menu click every time the player one pressed a button.
[/list]

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attack hitbox delay adjusted.
[*] Bots will now have a small delay between attacks depending on CPU level.
[/list]
